SELECT
  je.id,
  je.entry_date::text AS entry_date,
  je.ai_summary,
  je.ai_summary_error,
  je.edited_transcript,
  je.raw_transcript,
  je.created_at,
  COALESCE(ts.focus, '') AS tomorrow_focus
FROM public.journal_entries je
LEFT JOIN public.tomorrow_setups ts
  ON ts.journal_entry_id = je.id
 AND ts.user_id = je.user_id
WHERE je.user_id = '{{$node["Config"].json["userId"]}}'::uuid
ORDER BY je.entry_date DESC
LIMIT 1;
